result.topic_en: Methodological remarks on choosing among hypotheses about the middle-ear mechanism, and the definition of the 'listening' (lauschend) ear, in which the stapes footplate is pressed inward by the tensor tympani so that the ossicles are pressed together.
result.transcription:
zur Ergänzung der Deutung als möglich. Um [-unter-] diesen verschiedenen Möglichkeiten
die wahrscheinlichste herauszufinden, ist es vor allen Dingen nöthig, sich durch

items.english: To find the most probable among these various possibilities, it is above all necessary to obtain, by anatomical examination of fresh specimens, an approximate judgement of the elasticity, tension and thickness of the ligaments, membranes etc., which is impossible for me.
